tasks.gr12-listening-speaking-t2: Topic: Interviews, oral presentations, listening for attitude, formal responses. Grade 12 FAL learners respond critically to spoken texts, identify speaker attitude and bias through tone and word choice, maintain appropriate formal register in oral presentations, and evaluate interview techniques. Ask learners to identify attitude markers in spoken texts, distinguish between fact and opinion in interviews, choose effective formal oral response techniques, recognise bias in spoken language, and evaluate presentation strategies.
tasks.gr12-reading-viewing-t2: Topic: Novel or drama study, media texts, perspective, theme, critical literacy. Grade 12 FAL learners compare viewpoints across prescribed and media texts, justify interpretations with textual evidence, analyse how media layout and design convey meaning, and track theme development across a novel or drama. Ask learners to compare character perspectives, identify themes with supporting evidence, interpret media design features, analyse author's use of language for effect, and distinguish between connotative and denotative meaning.
tasks.gr12-writing-presenting-t2: Topic: Formal letter, review, article, speech, transactional precision. Grade 12 FAL learners write formal pieces with clear purpose, appropriate tone, correct format, and audience awareness. They practise planning, drafting, and editing transactional texts such as letters, newspaper articles, and reviews. Ask learners to identify format features of transactional texts, choose appropriate tone for audience and purpose, apply correct letter format conventions, identify errors in transactional writing, and select effective opening and closing techniques.
tasks.gr12-language-structures-t2: Topic: Connectors, passive voice, direct and indirect speech, cohesion, editing. Grade 12 FAL learners improve sentence coherence using connectors (however, therefore, although), convert between active and passive voice, change direct speech to indirect speech (and vice versa), and proofread for grammatical accuracy. Ask learners to choose the correct connector, convert active sentences to passive, change direct speech to reported speech, identify cohesion errors, and select grammatically correct sentence forms.
